test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 24 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is B related to E if A − B + C × D ÷ E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 to B
 
 

Given: A − B + C × D ÷ E

A − B → A is the brother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/876f76b30ffee3dd7c746d9831af686e4476e4cdb6854f8fa697d005f25ed937.png] 

B + C → B is the mother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bdbad825abdb6bc7754cc9e9047969d0decb442d04a7e42c017241c187dda3d.png] 

C × D → C is the wife of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49a646a24703612437ff3e2fb4ddc5d219848aa946a25310cbdd37f1794d5b31.png] 

D ÷ E → D is the father of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8ebdbc3c08612ba76e32b73ebbebb049836276faa3fdc7e393f7d76c42c15fd.png] 

Thus, B is the grandmother i.e. mother's mother of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
